text: 金十数据10月16日讯，李强主持召开国务院常务会议，会议讨论并原则通过《中华人民共和国价格法（修正草案）》，决定将草案提请全国人大常委会审议。会议指出，此次修正适应新形势新变化，进一步健全了价格治理机制，完善了政府定价程序，明确了不正当价格行为认定标准和法律责任。要依法依规治理低价无序竞争，健全行业成本调查、制止低价倾销等配套规则，加强价格执法监管。要持续规范平台经济领域价格竞争行为，引导企业不断提升产品和服务价值，营造公平有序市场环境。
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 16 - Li Qiang presided over a State Council executive meeting. The meeting discussed and approved in principle the Price Law of the People's Republic of China (Amendment Draft) and decided to submit the draft to the NPC Standing Committee for deliberation. The meeting noted that this amendment adapts to new situations and changes, further improves the price governance mechanism, refines government pricing procedures, and clarifies the criteria for identifying improper pricing behavior and legal liabilities. It is necessary to govern low-price disorderly competition in accordance with laws and regulations, improve supporting rules such as industry cost investigations and prohibition of below-cost dumping, and strengthen price law enforcement and supervision. It is necessary to continuously regulate price competition behavior in the platform economy, guide enterprises to continually enhance the value of products and services, and foster a fair and orderly market environment.
